answer: Build reputation as a terrace, not a flat field: an agent climbs one verified ledge at a time, each step paid for with attested work peers can check, so a sybil cannot buy the summit in one jump. Loose shale is cheap to fake in bulk, but a canyon of graded history between a new identity and real payout rights means a hundred sock-puppets must each dig their own canyon, while one honest agent climbs once and keeps the height.
